create.name: Sandra Rea
create.bio:
Sandra Rea is an Irish teacher of angel connection, meditation and energy work. Her own path opened in 2005 with a first Reiki treatment, and she went on to qualify as a Reiki Master and teacher before turning more and more towards working with angels, spirit guides and channelled messages. For years she offered angel healing, Reiki and intuitive mentoring from her practice, Angelic Bodies, and she has written for outlets such as OM Times and MindBodyGreen. Her book Angels Aid, published by O Books in 2016, offers simple angel-themed meditations that parents can read aloud to young children.

These days her teaching happens mostly online. She hosts the long-running Fiercely Spiritual Podcast and runs Fiercely Spiritual Family, a monthly membership with a library of guided meditations, a step-by-step path for building a relationship with your guardian angels, and live new and full moon gatherings. On YouTube she posts frequent short talks and longer guided practices that range from manifesting and gratitude to self-inquiry and resting in presence. Her tone is warm, practical and down to earth, and she lives in Ireland with her husband and two sons.

books.title: Angels Aid: Guided Meditation for Children and Parents
books.author: Sandra Rea
books.description: A book of short angel-themed meditations written so that a parent can read them aloud to a young child. It is meant as a gentle first step into meditation for families, and comes with an optional audio album.

courses.title: Fiercely Spiritual Family
courses.description: Sandra's online membership, holding all of her courses in one place. Members follow a four-phase path for building a relationship with their guardian angels, draw on a library of more than ninety guided meditations, and join two live group ceremonies a month around the new and full moon.
courses.price: €27 EUR a month (or €297 EUR a year)

free_resources.title: Sandra Rea on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations with an angelic theme, including chakra journeys, moon practices, abundance work and short breathing breaks. Listen at no cost in the app or a browser.

free_resources.title: Meet Your Guardian Angel
free_resources.description: A short free video training on first making contact with your guardian angel. You give your name and email to open it.

free_resources.title: Just Breathe - Mindful Exercises for Children and Parents
free_resources.description: A free ebook of simple mindfulness exercises a parent can share with a child at home. No earlier meditation experience is assumed; it is sent by email.
